segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Are you in the car yet? Keep me on speaker. Don't hang up.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: If the bank asks, tell them it's for a home renovation. Don't tell them it's crypto, they block it because they lose the fees.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'd rather go down to the office in person, thank you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your son doesn't need to be bothered with this. Don't tell him, we can resolve it in five minutes.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'm going to call the real number. Goodbye.
